change.summary: All countries start with a standard risk level on 29 June 2023. The Commission will then classify them as low or high risk based on deforestation and other criteria, publishing the final list by 30 June 2025.

obligations.text: Assign all countries a standard risk level on 29 June 2023.
obligations.quote: On 29 June 2023, all countries shall be assigned a standard level of risk.

obligations.text: Classify countries as low or high risk based on assessment criteria.
obligations.quote: The Commission shall classify countries or parts thereof, that present a low or high risk in accordance with paragraph 1 of this Article.

obligations.text: Publish the list of low and high risk countries by 30 June 2025.
obligations.quote: The list of the countries or parts thereof, that present a low or high risk shall be published by means of implementing acts to be adopted in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in Article 36(2), no later than 30 June 2025.

obligations.text: Review and update the risk list as often as necessary in light of new evidence.
obligations.quote: That list shall be reviewed, and updated if appropriate, as often as necessary in light of new evidence.

obligations.text: Conduct an objective and transparent assessment based on deforestation and other criteria.
obligations.quote: The classification of low-risk and high-risk countries or parts thereof, pursuant to paragraph 1 shall be based on an objective and transparent assessment by the Commission, taking into account the latest scientific evidence and internationally recognised sources.

obligations.text: Include reasons, invitation to respond, and consequences in the notification to high-risk countries.
obligations.quote: The Commission shall include the following information in the notification: (a) the reason or reasons for the intention to change the risk classification of the country or parts thereof; (b) the invitation to respond to the Commission in writing with regard to the intention to changing the risk classification of the country or parts thereof; (c) the consequences of its classification as a high or low risk country.

obligations.text: Allow countries sufficient time to reply to the Commission's notification.
obligations.quote: The Commission shall allow the country concerned sufficient time to reply to the notification.

obligations.text: Notify the country concerned and competent authorities without delay of inclusion or removal from the risk list.
obligations.quote: The Commission shall, without delay, notify the country concerned and the competent authorities of inclusion or removal of a country, or parts thereof, from the list referred to in paragraph 2.

reasons: The regulation change lists obligations only for the European Commission to classify countries by deforestation risk and publish risk lists.
Your shop is a seller of furniture and leather goods, not the Commission, so these specific obligations do not bind you.
